title: Depth after hardwiring inputs
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $n+m$ input bits, and fix an assignment to its last $m$ inputs. The circuit obtained by hardwiring those inputs has depth at most $	ext{depth}(C)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ assigns Boolean values to the last $m$ inputs
